description_expanded: SummaryDiscover the ultimate coastal getaway in our spacious Inlet Beach vacation rental. This luxury home features high-end amenities, including a private backyard with a gas grill and multiple decks for enjoying the salt air. Guests enjoy access to a shared community pool and private beach areas, with a seasonal tram running March through October to make travel effortless. Located near the boutiques of Rosemary Beach, our property provides the ideal blend of quiet relaxation and easy adventure.SpaceLocation perks: Rosemary Beach (0.6 miles), Alys Beach (0.9 miles), Inlet Beach (1.3 miles), Interior — Kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, blender, food processor, toaster oven, cooking utensils, tableware) — 5 Smart TVs (60” Samsung and 45” Roku) — Two In-unit washer and dryer sets — Free WiFi — Central heat and central A/C — 4,273 sq. ft. Exterior — Gas grill — Private backyard — Multiple decks and balconies — Outdoor dining area (6-person dining set) — Beach Access — Shared Community Pool — On-site parking for 4 cars (4 in driveway) Floor Configuration Main floor: Kitchen, dining area, living room, 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 en-suite bathroom, half bathroom Upper floor: Living room, laundry room, 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 bedroom (twin bed and crib), 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 en-suite bathroom, 1 shared full bathroom Lower floor: Living room, kitchenette, 1 bedroom (4 twin beds), 1 bedroom (2 queen beds), 1 full bathroom NeighborhoodInlet Beach is a serene coastal community known for its laid-back atmosphere and beautiful white-sand beaches. This neighborhood offers a perfect blend of quiet residential charm and convenient proximity to the vibrant boutiques and eateries in neighboring Rosemary Beach. Guests can enjoy a peaceful environment while remaining just a short trip away from the world-class dining and entertainment that the Florida coast is famous for. The area is a paradise for outdoor enthusiasts, offering seasonal activities such as biking along scenic trails, swimming in the turquoise waters of the Gulf, and exploring nearby state parks. Whether you are seeking a peaceful retreat or an active family vacation, the neighborhood provides a welcoming environment for all visitors. TransitWhile the home is located near a free shuttle line providing access to local attractions, a car is generally recommended for convenient travel throughout the area. On-site parking is provided for 4 vehicles in the private driveway. Walking and biking are popular ways to reach the beach and nearby shopping districts, and there are 0 steps required to access the home from the parking area. AccessGuests have full, private access to our property, including all 7 bedrooms, the private backyard, and various balconies. Amenities such as the in-unit laundry, gas grill, and kitchenette are private for guest use. Management provides 3 parking passes for the driveway. There are 0 steps to enter our property. Beach, pool, and seasonal tram access (March–October) are available via wristbands obtained through the front desk.NotesPlease be sure to return all wristbands. There are no golf carts or LSVs allowed in the neighborhood. Please check beach flags before entering the ocean.House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. Read Less
